the following: (1) theoretical simulations for computing dual‐frequency reflectivities for liquid and solid precipitating hydrometeos; (2) the derivation of empirical dual‐band relations between reflectivities at Ku‐band and S‐band frequencies for liquid and solid particles, and the study of the variability of these relations; (3) the application of the proposed empirical dual‐frequency reflectivitiy conversion relations to real data collected by the prototype polarimetric radar,
